properties.description: cuscope load generator: warehouse CTAS passes over the lakehouse table, 0-10 per run. Mood mirrors harvester/cuscope/loadgen.py (shared day regime, 2-hour storm blocks, exponential run size); a random 0-20 minute wait before each run removes the fixed schedule grain. Labels make the queries easy to find in queryinsights.

scripts.text:
SELECT TOP 100 category, region, SUM(amount) AS amount
FROM dbo.agg_hourly
GROUP BY category, region
ORDER BY amount DESC
OPTION (LABEL = 'loadgen_top');
